{{Top|leg}}
'''Vice President''' was the title given to individuals who were second in command of a large company.

Individuals with this title included:
*[[Dees Harbright]], Senior Vice President of Marketing for [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation]]
*[[Bronwynn Koft]], [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]]
*[[Mirkovig Hirken]], Vice President (also [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]]) of [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]
*[[Dimone Irrv]], Executive Vice President of Operations for [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]
